primary_metric: arithmetic mean per-request client TPOT, (last event-first event)*1000/(2048-1)
method: Pause P; admit D requests; bootstrap grace; pause D; resume P; require all P KV-transfer-completed records; release both D replicas concurrently
readiness: Exact phase request count of P RequestStats finished after RDMA transfer; no time-based decode release
limitation: Staging TTFT is artificial; this tests decode capacity, not normal end-to-end service latency
attempt1: Excluded: manual early release required after bootstrap race
